title: refactor(plugin-auth): move AuthManager's audience gate and membership admission into auth-manager-membership-admission.ts (#25224 cut 8)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuMjbPDrsigsyqoKsV4WZQMz)_

Part of #25224
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Ruling-ref: 6348891160, 6364006498

The basis for the `Clause-②: no` line: this is a move. No accept set, export, route, refusal, code or answer changes. The `.d.ts` bar is ruling `6348891160` item 1 (on #25222, covering this card). `@objectstack/plugin-auth`'s published `dist/index.d.ts` and `dist/index.d.mts` are raw byte-identical to base (0 diff lines, so the union-order normalisation has nothing to do), with the ruling's positive control. Its entry exports the same 159 names under ESM and CJS (measured below). Ruling `6364006498` (Sales's ruling A on this card, for bodies that read shared unexported helpers) is cited because the claim runs under it; no body in this cut reads such a helper, so its `index.ts` name list does not land here.

Cut 8 of the `auth-manager.ts` split: **who may join, and what joining settles.** Four `AuthManager` method bodies (163 lines) move unedited, re-indented one level, into one new module, `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager-membership-admission.ts`. #25224 stays open for the later cuts.

This follows the amended claim `6365318480`, which amends `6363170079` on the file cut 7 left (#25404, landed note `6364312052`). The shape is cuts 1 to 7's, which is #23050's.

Branch: `claude/project-thread-lg3wrj`, the harness-pinned branch for this session, restarted from `origin/main` `f0fdd45bbc` after #25404 merged. It names no issue, so the card relation is this body's first line.

`auth-manager.ts` goes from 8,909 to 8,790 lines. The cut is +321 / −173 over 5 files: 494 changed lines, under the 3,000-line line. It is not a governed surface (`check-governed-merges.mjs --branch HEAD`: 0 of the 5 paths hit the register). Two commits: the move, and the census documents `--write` regenerates for it.

## Why this seam

These are the audience gate and what a new user's creation settles:
- `validateAudienceAdmission`: the gate better-auth's `user.validateUserInfo` callback runs on every user creation. It asks the manager the bootstrap, invitation and operator-provisioning questions, gives the audience verdict and refusal codes, and stages the owner-verified stamp and the self-registration grant;
- `settleMembership`: the membership reconciler's one assembly of inputs, which both creation seams call, with the live membership policy;
- `landSelfRegistrationGrant`: the self-registration permission set written for the membership's organization, idempotently;
- `reportUngrantedSelfRegistrant`: the durability-level report of a grant that did not land.

What stays, and why:
- `settleSelfRegistrationGrant` stays. Its body does `this.pendingSelfRegistrationGrants.delete(email)` (`:5857`). The tenant-audit census reads a `this.` receiver's type from class property declarations only, so in the new module that call is a receiver it cannot read, and `check-tenant-audit-census` fails with an untyped-receiver problem (measured on a draft that moved it). Placing it would need a new `UNTYPED_RECEIVERS` row in `scripts/tenant-audit-census.mjs`, a ledger that is shrink-only. In the class, the census reads it as before.
- `sendExistingAccountSignUpNotice` stays: `auth-email-locale.test.ts` describes the auth mail surface by its call sites (see the finding at the end).
- The membership-area methods that read a `private static` stay, as agreed with the seat: reading one from outside the class is TS2341, and making it public would change the `.d.ts`.

## What moved

| method | base signature line | body lines | members it reads |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| `settleMembership` | `:4899` | 24 | `config`, `getMembershipPolicy` |
| `validateAudienceAdmission` | `:5158` | 112 | `audienceLogError`, `config`, `enterpriseOAuthProviderIds`, `getAudience`, `hasPendingInvitationFor`, `isBootstrapCreation`, `isOperatorProvisioning`, `selfRegistrationSetResolvable`, `stageOwnerVerifiedStamp`, `stageSelfRegistrationGrant` |
| `landSelfRegistrationGrant` | `:5894` | 19 | `config` |
| `reportUngrantedSelfRegistrant` | `:6057` | 8 | `audienceLogError` |

Lines are base `f0fdd45bbc`. The members come from a walk of every `this.X` in each body with the TypeScript compiler API. No body has a bare `this`, `this[...]`, `arguments` or `super`, or a `this` inside a `function` or a nested class. No body assigns to a `this` member or reads a module-level declaration of `auth-manager.ts`.

**The one value read of `AuthManager`.** `validateAudienceAdmission` reads the public static `AuthManager.OPERATOR_PROVISIONING_TICKET_FIELD` (base `:5183`). So the new module imports `AuthManager` by value from `./auth-manager.js`, the first cut in the series to do so. That is the only value read: the module's other `AuthManager` mentions are the host interface's indexed-access types and comments. It sits inside the function body and runs only when better-auth calls the gate. The module's top level is six imports, an interface and four function declarations, so nothing reads the class while the two modules are first evaluated.

**Imports.** These leave `auth-manager.ts`, each now with no reader there, and the new module imports each from the same place:
- `classifyCreationMethod`, `decideAudienceAdmission`, `AUDIENCE_CONFIG_ERROR` and `type AudienceCreationClass` from `./audience-posture.js` (the line stays for its six other names);
- `shouldStampOwnerVerifiedAtCreation` (`./walled-owner-operator-stamp.js`) and `GRANT_SET_NAME_FIELD` (`./grant-set-name.js`), whose import lines go;
- `reconcileMembership` (`./reconcile-membership.js`). The line stays for `type MembershipPolicy` and `type ReconcileOutcome`, the second still `settleMembership`'s return type on the class.

The new module also imports `withSystemReadContext` from `./objectql-adapter.js`, which `auth-manager.ts` keeps importing.

**Evaluation order.** The three modules whose value import leaves are now first reached through the new module's import line, later in `auth-manager.ts`'s import list. Their top levels are declarations and literal constants. Every module they import (`@objectstack/types`, `@objectstack/core`, `@objectstack/spec/security`, `./auth-actor-attribution.js`) is imported by `auth-manager.ts` above the new module's line. So the change in order cannot be observed.

## The shape

- **The class keeps all four methods** at their places, with their names, signatures and docblocks: the published `.d.ts` lists each one. Each body is now a host literal of exactly the members that body reads, typed as a `Pick` of `MembershipAdmissionHost`, plus `.call`.
- **`MembershipAdmissionHost`** lives in the new module. It names the 11 members the bodies read, each typed as the class member (`AuthManager['config']`, …).
- **Every method goes as a late-bound closure** (`(...a) => this.m(...a)`), so a double or spy set on the manager is still the one a body reaches: the bootstrap, invitation and operator-provisioning probes, the two stagings and `getMembershipPolicy` (a live platform setting) all stay on the class.
- **`config` goes as a getter.** The class reassigns it after construction (`setRuntimeBaseUrl`, `applyConfigPatch`), so it is read off the manager when a body reads it, as before.
- **The three `async` methods are no longer `async`.** Each returns the moved async function's own promise, so a caller awaits the same promise the body settles. Building the host cannot throw, so no method now throws synchronously where it used to reject. `reportUngrantedSelfRegistrant` was synchronous and stays so.
- **The cost:** one small host object per call. The four run on user creation (and `validateAudienceAdmission` also on the password sign-up route) and on the self-registration grant's paths, not on every request.
- **Nothing re-exports the new module**, so the published surface does not move.

## Path readers

**Migrated in this PR:**
- **The tenant-audit census and its two documents.** The moved `landSelfRegistrationGrant` carries one census site, the `sys_user_permission_set` insert (base `:5907`). `node scripts/tenant-audit-census.mjs --write` (the second commit) moves its row in `docs/audits/2026-08-tenant-audit-write-call-sites.counts.md` from `auth-manager.ts` to the new file. It also re-measures the corpus-scale block in both documents, which the checker does not enforce: measured at `487d57fed` (the move commit), 723 tracked sources scanned (716 at the last write; 722 at base, 723 at head) and 174 same-named calls subtracted (172 at the last write; 174 at base and head). No prose figure moves, and `check-tenant-audit-census` exits 0.
- **`find-envelope-limb-removal.test.ts`'s B5 `site:` label**, which named `auth-manager.ts` as the file of the `sys_user_permission_set` existence read. That read moves with `landSelfRegistrationGrant`, so the label names the new file. It is a test-title string only; no gate or test reads it back.

**Measured as reading no moved line:**
- **`check-dispatcher-error-vocabulary.mjs`** and **`api-error-code.pin.test.ts`'s `authManagerFiles` floor**: no `new APIError(` sits in the moved bodies. The gate reads 56 sites found and 56 classified at base and at head.
- **The plugin-factory scans** in `better-auth-schema-parity.test.ts` and `managed-extension-fields.test.ts`: the imports that leave are local modules, not plugin factories, and the moved text has no dynamic import.
- **`check-auth-mount-ledger.mjs`** and **`auth-manager-base-path.test.ts`**: no base-path literal or declaration sits in the moved text.
- **The system-context census** reads 148 elevation read sites at base and at head.
- **Callers through the manager**: the suites that drive the four methods call each through the class method, and all pass at head (below):
  - `audience-posture.test.ts` (the gate's verdicts and refusal codes);
  - `logger-receiver-detach.test.ts` (the degradation report's logger receiver);
  - `find-envelope-limb-removal.test.ts` (the grant's existence read);
  - `self-registration-grant-first-membership.test.ts` (the grant's landing);
  - `dev-admin-seed-credential-gate.test.ts` (operator provisioning through the gate; it reads `AuthManager.OPERATOR_PROVISIONING_TICKET_FIELD` itself);
  - `signup-existing-address-refusal.test.ts`.
- **Every symbol anchor into the file.** Before the cut, every `auth-manager.ts#symbol` anchor in the tracked tree outside changelogs was mapped with `symbolSegmentResolution` from `scripts/symbol-anchors.mjs`. There are 29, and all 29 are `declaration`-class at base, with the 4 bodies blanked, and at head. None names a moved method. Two name a token the moved text also carries, and both resolve on declarations that stay: `#AuthManager` (ADR-0135; the moved gate reads `AuthManager.OPERATOR_PROVISIONING_TICKET_FIELD`) and `#isBootstrapCreation` (`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/identity-auth.json:1810`; the gate calls `this.isBootstrapCreation`).

## The decision-letter layer does not move

The seat asks each cut's report for this count at both ends. `check-adr-anchors`' decision-letter layer reads 2,004 at base `f0fdd45bbc` and 2,004 at head, and the gate exits 0 at both. The moved text cites `ADR-0078` without a decision letter, so only the number layer sees it move: 52,156 citations at both, across 6,632 files at base and 6,633 at head. No anchor entry is added for the new module, as for cuts 1 to 7's modules.

## Proof

Builds and suites ran through `os-verify-lock`, and every exit code was captured before any pipe. Base `f0fdd45bbc`, head `fa0187ad1f` (the move is `487d57fedd`). A full `turbo run build` ran first. Then `plugin-auth` was built and its suite run at base, then built and run at head, on the same dependency dists.

**1. The moved text.**
- For each of the 4 methods, the base class body and the new module's function body are the same TypeScript token sequence (scanner tokens, kind and text, trivia skipped, each template literal re-scanned at its substitutions as the parser does).
- Every line is the base line minus exactly two leading spaces, and the parameters and return type are the same text.
- Each class method keeps its docblock and signature, with `async` dropped from the three that had it.
- Result: 4 of 4 pass, 163 body lines.

| method | body lines | tokens |
|---|---:|---:|
| `settleMembership` | 24 | 93 |
| `validateAudienceAdmission` | 112 | 466 |
| `landSelfRegistrationGrant` | 19 | 154 |
| `reportUngrantedSelfRegistrant` | 8 | 22 |

- **Negative control:** one token changed in the module (`'sys_user_permission_set'` → `'sys_user_permission_sets'` in `landSelfRegistrationGrant`'s insert) makes that method fail (tokens and lines DIFFER), and the run exits 1. Restored afterwards; `cmp` against the saved copy was clean.
- **An independent reading:** `git diff --color-moved=plain --color-moved-ws=allow-indentation-change f0fdd45bbc fa0187ad1f` over the two source files marks 161 of the 165 deleted lines and 167 of the 313 added lines as moved.
  - The other 4 deleted lines are the `reconcileMembership` import line and the three `async` signature lines.
  - The other added lines are the stubs' host literals, `MembershipAdmissionHost`, the module header, the per-function pointer docblocks and the import blocks.

**2. `.d.ts` and exports (ruling `6348891160` items 1 and 2).**

| file | raw base | raw head | raw diff lines | normalised base | normalised head |
|---|---|---|---:|---|---|
| `dist/index.d.ts` | `12679e13f74973b0510551a65b50808e7c3936a2d273cf2f262a9196648c0737` | `12679e13f74973b0510551a65b50808e7c3936a2d273cf2f262a9196648c0737` | 0 | `c7a9fa25f118cfec858d770b979767744d27d9757a9ea4063faeea6238c33c01` | `c7a9fa25f118cfec858d770b979767744d27d9757a9ea4063faeea6238c33c01` |
| `dist/index.d.mts` | `df57562ff950159e738d790cb7ee82a655ba0fffddafe4153bdcc50c4537336f` | `df57562ff950159e738d790cb7ee82a655ba0fffddafe4153bdcc50c4537336f` | 0 | `68f824aea0947d9895b968ed46a7972eaae43ef0f2bda7e3ba9113002233ade6` | `68f824aea0947d9895b968ed46a7972eaae43ef0f2bda7e3ba9113002233ade6` |

- The normaliser, verbatim (the ruling's one-liner): `node -e 'const s=require("fs").readFileSync(process.argv[1],"utf8");process.stdout.write(s.replace(/"[^"\n]*"(?:\s*\|\s*"[^"\n]*")+/g,r=>r.split(/\s*\|\s*/).sort().join(" | ")))' dist/index.d.ts | sha256sum`.
- The raw files are already byte-identical, so no union-order swap occurs in this cut: items 1(b) and 1(d) hold with nothing to account for.
- **Positive control:** the head `dist/index.d.ts` with one private member made public (`private validateAudienceAdmission;` → `validateAudienceAdmission;`, line 2107, a one-line change) hashes raw `a44eb00dde9098cdcb14efc26e659d46f940a6df42d3cc1759bb78ad6d0f1db8` and normalised `df635741a7c0a9d7d3f34be34bc52a32ea6406d9ada1112acd0de9f924990750`. Both differ from the readings above.
- **Export lists:** ESM `dist/index.mjs` and CJS `dist/index.js` each have 159 names at base and at head, the same list (the sha256 of the sorted names is `3abb126f5babb701…` on all four).
- **The bundle:** 18 files in `dist/` on both sides, the same list. Only `index.js`, `index.mjs` and their two `.map` files differ, as a move of code inside the bundle must.

**3. Tests and lint.**
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=3` in `packages/plugins/plugin-auth`: base `Test Files 189 passed (189)`, `Tests 3580 passed | 10 skipped (3590)`, exit 0. Head: the same counts, exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth typecheck` (both `tsc` projects and `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck`: exit 0.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` (the root `lint` script's binary and flags) over the 3 source files: exit 0.

**4. The census and the anchors, at base and at head.**
- The tenant-audit census (`node scripts/tenant-audit-census.mjs --json`), compared per site with the new module's file name mapped back to `auth-manager.ts`: 238 sites on both sides, 1 in the new module at head, 0 per-site differences in object, verb, tenancy, context and elevation, 0 unresolved and 0 unledgered on both, and every total the same.
- These checkers were run by hand at base and at head, because `dispatch-gates` does not derive the ADR one. All six exit 0 at both:
  - `check-adr-symbol-anchors`: 2,384 anchors across 142 records, 466 symbol (440 declaration, 26 literal), at both.
  - `check-adr-anchors`: 80 anchored files at both; the decision-letter layer reads 2,004 at both, as above.
  - `check-scripts-symbol-anchors` (4,061 anchors), `check-spec-docblock-symbol-anchors` (5,071 anchors, both read in the same built tree), `check-system-context-census` (148 elevation read sites) and `check-platform-checklist` (16 areas, 329 items): the same reading at both.

**5. Gates.**
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 89 commands for the 5 paths. All 89 ran at `fa0187ad1f` after the full build, and all 89 exited 0.
- `--ran` over the record with each exit code: 89 derived, 89 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, a derived zero.
- `check-governed-merges.mjs --branch HEAD`: NOT governed, 494 changed lines.
- **Docs drift** (`node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f0fdd45bbc`, exit 0): 12 pages, 6 of them release-owned. Every one is listed through `sys_user_permission_set`, a literal `landSelfRegistrationGrant` carries unchanged. No page restates a rule this move changes, so no doc edit is owed.
- **Serial constraints** (in the claim): 11 PRs are open, and none touches `plugin-auth/src`, the census script or its two documents, or a reader above. `origin/main` is still `f0fdd45bbc`.

## Finding, outside this cut

The population comments in `plugin-auth/src/auth-email-locale.test.ts` (around `:44`, `:179` and `:857`–`:865`) describe the auth mail surface as five `sendTemplate` call sites, and say no other file under `plugin-auth/src` calls one. On base there are six: five in `auth-manager.ts` and one in `auth-manager-email-sms-delivery.ts` (moved there by cut 5). This cut touches neither the sends nor the comments, and the comments are not a gate. Reported on the card for the seat to triage.

## Changeset

None: `skip-changeset`, per ruling `6348891160` item 4. The published declarations and export lists are unchanged, and the bundle's bytes move only because code moved inside it.
